en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, form his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said:

‘They came with a pick-pocket who had picked some Dirhams from a man. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If he has picked it from his outer shirt, I<sup>asws</sup> would not cut his (hand), but if he picked is from his inner shirt, I<sup>asws</sup> would cut his (hand)’.
